# Load Data
## PNG
```{r}
############### RAW FILES ############### 
raw_data_png <- c(
  "../data/example_MAGPIX_plate1.csv",
  "../data/example_MAGPIX_plate2.csv",
  "../data/example_MAGPIX_plate3.csv"
)
raw_data_filenames_png <- c(
  "example_MAGPIX_plate1.csv",
  "example_MAGPIX_plate2.csv",
  "example_MAGPIX_plate3.csv"
)
platform <- "magpix"
plate_layout_png <- "../data/example_platelayout_1.xlsx"

############### DATA PROCESSING ############### 
serodata_png                <- readSeroData(raw_data_png, raw_data_filenames_png, platform)
antigen_output_png          <- readAntigens(serodata_png)
plate_list_png              <- readPlateLayout(plate_layout_png, antigen_output_png)
processed_counts_png        <- process_counts(antigen_output_png)
antigencounts_png           <- getAntigenCounts(processed_counts_png, plate_list_png)
counts_png                  <- getCounts(processed_counts_png)
counts_QC_output_png        <- getCountsQC(antigencounts_png, counts_png)

############### MFI TO RAU ############### 
mfitorau_png <- MFItoRAU_PNG(antigen_output_png, plate_list_png, counts_QC_output_png)

############### classification ############### 
results_of_classification <- classify_final_results(mfitorau_png, "antibody_model", "maximised", counts_QC_output_png)
mfitorau_png[[1]]
```
